# Teather

> Teather lets free websites save each user's data (settings, notes, drafts, copies of work) in the user's own Google Drive, through one script tag and no backend.

- [Integration guide](https://teather.technologylearningcompany.com/integrate.md): everything needed to add Teather to a site, including registration, storage, sign-in, files, testing and a checklist.
- [Client library](https://teather.technologylearningcompany.com/v1/teather.js): the script sites load, with the full API in its comments.
- [Privacy](https://teather.technologylearningcompany.com/privacy.html) and [terms](https://teather.technologylearningcompany.com/terms.html).
